failure_summary.description: Chose a salient related referent instead of the entity or type specified by the clue's wording and identifying details.
Returned an overextended or grammatically mismatched form instead of the requested minimal lexical answer.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already requires identifying the answer slot, checking the full clue, using the requested part of speech, and returning the shortest unambiguous answer. These failures reflect not applying those rules, so adding similar guidance would be duplicative.
